parameters.query:
INSERT INTO vehicle_notifications (
  is_pdr,
  pdr_reminder_for,
  is_aggressive_mode,
  organization_id,
  "vehicleRegistration",
  "notificationType",
  "notificationChannel",
  "personName",
  email,
  "phoneNumber",
  "emailMessage",
  "dutyDate",
  "notificationDate",
  status,
  user_id,
  my_vehicle_id,
  "createdAt"
)
SELECT
  true,
  vn.duty_batch_id,
  false,
  vn.organization_id,
  vn."vehicleRegistration",
  vn."notificationType",
  vn."notificationChannel",
  vn."personName",
  vn.email,
  vn."phoneNumber",
  vn."notificationType" || ' pre ' || vn."vehicleRegistration" || ' — potvrdená. Naplánujete ďalšiu?',
  vn."dutyDate",
  NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day',
  'imported',
  vn.user_id,
  vn.my_vehicle_id,
  NOW()
FROM vehicle_notifications vn
WHERE vn.confirmation_token = '{{ $('Check If Human (Not Bot)').item.json.query.id }}'
  AND vn.aggressive_start IS NOT NULL
  AND vn.aggressive_end IS NOT NULL
  AND NOW() BETWEEN vn.aggressive_start AND vn.aggressive_end
  AND vn.duty_batch_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM vehicle_notifications sub
    WHERE sub.is_pdr = true
      AND sub.pdr_reminder_for = vn.duty_batch_id
  )
LIMIT 1;
